John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.overview: John Danaher's front headlock system, eight volumes. Volume 1 is the overview. Volume 2 covers reactive entries (getting the front headlock off the opponent's shots). Volume 3 covers kneeling front headlocks (the high wrist series). Volume 4 covers the front kata gatame / anaconda (including the Olympic-style and leg-assisted versions). Volume 5 covers the darce (inverted kata gatame) and the seated kata gatame. Volume 6 covers seated front headlocks (seated guard snap downs). Volume 7 covers the hip heist and collar tie hip heist. Volume 8 covers guard passing with the front headlock (guillotines against seated guard).
John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.for: No-gi grapplers who want to punish shots and attack the neck.

John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.overview: John Danaher's kimura system, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the overview and the 'trinity of power'. Volume 2 covers the dorsal kimura and unlocking reinforced hands. Volume 3 covers the T-kimura (top and bottom knee). Volume 4 covers side kimura applications. Volume 5 covers the kimura against butterfly guard. Volume 6 covers the kimura against the single leg, countering the peek-out and kesa gatame. Volume 7 covers bottom half guard to T-kimura and the kimura / armbar dilemma. Volume 8 covers the legs kimura / reverse omoplata and the 'trimura'.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.for: No-gi grapplers who want the kimura as a control and finishing system.
key: Kimura vs butterfly guard and single leg

John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.overview: John Danaher's triangle system, eight volumes, covering the whole family of triangles. Volume 1 covers the multiplicity of triangles and the two-stage approach. Volume 2 covers front triangle mechanics. Volume 3 covers set-ups (collar tie, overhook grip). Volume 4 covers front triangles from top while passing. Volume 5 covers the front triangle, opposite triangle and elbow control, and sweeping with the opposite triangle. Volume 6 covers rear triangle mechanics and entries from the back. Volume 7 covers attacking the turtle with the side triangle. Volume 8 covers the reverse triangle (gyaku sankaku).
John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.for: Gi or no-gi grapplers who want triangles from everywhere.
